card.name: Gold therapy before gold drug names
card.fires_on: Words right after 'injectable gold' or 'treated with' in gold-salt drug warnings, such as the opening parenthesis or the 's' of 'sodium aurothiomalate', and 'with' before Auranofin.

modes.label: After injectable gold
modes.description: The opening parenthesis or first letter of the bracketed drug name following 'injectable gold'.
modes.example: have been reported rarely in patients on therapy with injectable gold<< (>>sodium aurothiomalate

modes.label: Treated with Auranofin
modes.description: The word 'with' just before the gold drug Auranofin.
modes.example: (See ADVERSE REACTIONS ) treated<< with>> Auranofin Capsules (aur

card.writes: It pushes down metal and mineral words like metal, copper and mine, so the model avoids metal-related continuations after gold.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a gold-based arthritis drug is about to be named, not metal mining or ore.
